razonamiento: The visual diagram illustrates the Lagoon application delivery platform architecture on AWS. Developers commit code to a third-party Git server, which triggers Lagoon running on Amazon EKS via webhooks. Amazon EKS orchestrates workloads across standard Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon EC2 Spot instances. Both instance pools interface with persistent storage in Amazon EBS (gp3) and Amazon EFS, and query databases in Amazon Aurora (Graviton2). Spoken references to OpenSearch/Solr were contextual examples and are omitted as separate nodes in favor of the drawn components.
